domain.description: Target domain to enumerate (fully qualified). Required.

dnsserver.description: DNS server to use for A/NS/MX queries. AXFR/PTR go to domain's NS.

whois.description: Perform WHOIS queries on discovered class C netranges.

reverse.description: Enable reverse lookups on netranges (set to false to disable).

threads.description: Number of threads for concurrent queries.

verbose.description: Enable verbose progress and error output.

pages.description: Number of Google search pages to scrape (requires scrap > 0).

scrap.description: Maximum number of subdomains to scrape from Google (0 = skip scraping).

subfile.description: Path to file containing subdomain wordlist for brute force.

recursion.description: Enable recursion: brute-force subdomains that have NS records.

delay.description: Maximum seconds to wait between WHOIS queries (randomized).

exclude.description: Regular expression to exclude PTR records from reverse lookups.

subout.description: Path to file to write all valid discovered subdomains.

private.description: Include private IPs in the final domain_ips.txt output.
